description: Endpoint link down and up on the B-02 topology. The link of hca3 goes down, so hca3 leaves the subnet, its LID leaves every forwarding table and stops answering. After the ReLink it returns with the same LID. A management simulation.

checks.description: rfl-ibsim:m4 in the Track B guest is the image the lock pins as ibsim.image, and the run starts that digest.
checks.detail: rfl-ibsim:m4 in ibsim1 is sha256:cb3e3550f4f60de5414abe55dbe81e45fd68106ef5ecc4cfa4d701b6083ee279, the ibsim.image pin

checks.description: The guest is a VM with the Track B marker on the locked kernel. The fabric container runs as 10001:10001, not privileged, with no network, no device, every capability dropped, no-new-privileges, a read-only root, AppArmor docker-default, read-only mounts, and no image-wide LD_PRELOAD. docker top shows UID 10001 for every process.
checks.detail: ibsim1 is a kvm guest on kernel 6.8.0-147-generic; the container runs the locked image as 10001:10001 with no network, no device, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, a read-only root and AppArmor docker-default, and every process in it runs as UID 10001

checks.description: OpenSM logs SUBNET UP, every sweep routes with the scenario's routing engine, and sminfo reports SMINFO_MASTER at the LID of the SM host port.
checks.detail: master at LID 1, 1 SUBNET UP, every sweep routed by minhop

checks.description: ibnetdiscover finds exactly the nodes, with kind and port count, and the links of the topology file.
checks.detail: 2 switches, 4 HCAs and 6 links, as expected

checks.description: Every linked HCA port has a non-zero LID with LMC 0, and no two ports share a LID.
iblinkinfo shows every linked port Active/LinkUp facing its peer from the topology file, every unlinked switch port Down/Polling.
checks.detail: 20 ports as expected, 12 of them Active/LinkUp

checks.description: ibroute of every switch forwards every endpoint LID one hop closer to its endpoint and keeps no LID that no port holds.
checks.detail: 8 switch routes to endpoint LIDs, each one hop closer to its endpoint

checks.description: A LID-routed smpquery nodedesc from the SM host reaches every LID and answers with the node name of the topology file.
checks.detail: 6 LIDs answer with their node name

checks.description: ibsim accepts the Unlink of the fault port, and OpenSM logs a new SUBNET UP within the timeout.
checks.detail: ibsim accepted Unlink "hca3"[1]; OpenSM logged SUBNET UP 1 more time(s), the first 0.042 s after the command

checks.description: After the fault, discovery equals the topology without that link, reduced to what the SM reaches. Port states follow it, LIDs are kept.
checks.detail: 2 switches, 3 HCAs and 5 links, as expected; 19 ports as expected, 10 of them Active/LinkUp; every endpoint kept its LID

checks.description: After the fault, every switch routes every remaining endpoint LID one hop closer over the degraded topology, and the routes that used the failed link moved or left with their LID.
checks.detail: 6 switch routes to endpoint LIDs, each one hop closer to its endpoint; 1 routes used the failed link: 0 moved to another port, 1 removed with their LID

checks.description: After the fault, every LID still in the fabric answers smpquery nodedesc with its name, and every cut-off LID stays silent.
checks.detail: 5 LIDs answer with their node name, 1 cut-off LIDs stay silent

checks.description: ibsim accepts the ReLink of the fault port, and OpenSM logs a new SUBNET UP within the timeout.
checks.detail: ibsim accepted ReLink "hca3"[1]; OpenSM logged SUBNET UP 1 more time(s), the first 0.047 s after the command

checks.description: After the ReLink, discovery, port states, LIDs, routes and reachability equal the baseline topology again.
checks.detail: 2 switches, 4 HCAs and 6 links, as expected; 20 ports as expected, 12 of them Active/LinkUp; every endpoint kept its LID; 8 switch routes to endpoint LIDs, each one hop closer to its endpoint; 6 LIDs answer with their node name

checks.description: After the run, guest.sh stop removed the fabric container and guest.sh ls lists no container of this run.
checks.detail: guest.sh stop removed rfl-ibsim-20261115T151655Z-b-03; no Track B container remains

checks.description: At the start and the end of the run the host runs no ibsim, OpenSM or diagnostic tool process and lists no Track B container.
checks.detail: no simulator process and no Track B container on the host at the start and the end of the run

security.device_exposure: None. ibsim, OpenSM and the tools run in one unprivileged container with no network inside the Track B guest. No device node is mounted. MADs travel over ibsim's Unix socket through libumad2sim.
